scope: Official GPX availability and 2027 course-version review for top-level events 81–90
safetyRules: Existing GPX files remain valid until an official replacement is downloaded, parsed and validated.
No existing GPX files were deleted, overwritten or replaced.
Participant-only GPX releases and future final-route publication are not treated as public downloads.
Do not label 2025/2026 course files as current 2027 routes.

checks.detail: Big's Backyard Ultra race listing confirms Sunday 15 August 2027 in Germany and a 6,706m loop. Last Soul site also describes Season 3 / 2027 qualification events and German final in August. No public direct GPX download found; do not assume the same loop geometry without organizer file.

Current race calendar reports 14 August 2027, 75km/5200hm main course and new 25km/1500hm Short Trail. A GPX track is expected/required for participants according to event listing, but no direct official download URL was retrieved in this pass. Treat metrics as provisional until organizer course data confirms.

Current 2027 event listing confirms 20–22 August 2027, five solo distances, relay and kids races. Older app checkpoint's 2026 files must remain historical. Need inspect each 2027 course href/version before importing.

Official site confirms 18–24 September 2027 and seven stages, over 250km / 15,000m+ in total. Current route overview still says 2026. Official FAQ explicitly states GPX data are sent only to registered participants. Do not reuse 2026 stage files as 2027.
No confirmed 2027 race programme or GPX version established in this review. Preserve 2026 routes as historical only and wait for official 2027 announcement.
Organizer page currently shows 4 September 2026, 6.7km / about 90hm and a GPX download for that edition. The 2026 event is past; no 2027 date or 2027 route file found. Do not reuse 2026 track.

Official 2027 regulation confirms all three distances and says maps/descriptions/GPS tracks are documented online, but organizer may change courses until 31 July 2027 when final official route is published. Do not treat current GPX as final; re-download after 31 July.

Previous official GPX platform identified its downloadable pack as 2026. A 2027 date is listed by event calendar, but current official route/GPX pack has not been verified. Do not use 2026 pack as 2027.

Official homepage confirms 3–4 September 2027. Z101 is 101+km/7600m+ and TUX070 70km/4400m+. Previously checked official download links point to Z101 2025 and TUX070/RK50 2026; reject those as 2027 tracks. Check all seven current route pages for updated GPX links.

Current official homepage shows 2027 tickets and the standard 6.7km backyard format. It does not expose a public direct GPX link on the main page. Previous checkpoint says AGB confirms a marked 6.706km route; obtain direct file from organizer or participant area and validate.
